profiles_measurements_chk.name: profiles_measurements_chk
profiles_measurements_chk.value:
(body_weight_kg is null or (body_weight_kg > 0 and body_weight_kg <= 500))
        and (height_cm is null or (height_cm >= 50 and height_cm <= 260))

profiles_username_chk.name: profiles_username_chk
profiles_username_chk.value:
username ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._]{1,18}[a-z0-9]$'
        and username not like '%..%' and not public.username_reserved(username)

exercise_equipment_options_select.name: exercise_equipment_options_select
exercise_equipment_options_select.using: user_id is null or user_id = (select auth.uid())

exercise_equipment_options_target_chk.name: exercise_equipment_options_target_chk
exercise_equipment_options_target_chk.value: equipment_type_id is not null or equipment_instance_id is not null

exercises_select.name: exercises_select
exercises_select.using: user_id is null or user_id = (select auth.uid())

program_days_day_of_week_chk.name: program_days_day_of_week_chk
program_days_day_of_week_chk.value: day_of_week is null or day_of_week between 1 and 7

program_exercises_reps_chk.name: program_exercises_reps_chk
program_exercises_reps_chk.value: rep_min is null or rep_max is null or rep_min <= rep_max

program_exercises_distance_chk.name: program_exercises_distance_chk
program_exercises_distance_chk.value:
(distance_min_meters is null or distance_min_meters >= 0)
        and (distance_max_meters is null or distance_max_meters >= 0)
        and (distance_min_meters is null or distance_max_meters is null
          or distance_min_meters <= distance_max_meters)

set_logs_values_chk.name: set_logs_values_chk
set_logs_values_chk.value:
(reps is null or reps >= 0)
        and (rir is null or rir >= 0)
        and (duration_seconds is null or duration_seconds >= 0)
        and (distance_meters is null or distance_meters >= 0)
        and (technique_rating is null or technique_rating between 1 and 5)

workout_exercises_superset_group_chk.name: workout_exercises_superset_group_chk
workout_exercises_superset_group_chk.value: superset_group is null or (length(superset_group) between 1 and 60)

workout_sessions_scales_chk.name: workout_sessions_scales_chk
workout_sessions_scales_chk.value:
(sleep_quality is null or sleep_quality between 1 and 5)
        and (energy is null or energy between 1 and 5)
        and (fatigue is null or fatigue between 1 and 5)
        and (soreness is null or soreness between 1 and 5)

daily_recovery_scales_chk.name: daily_recovery_scales_chk
daily_recovery_scales_chk.value:
(sleep_quality is null or sleep_quality between 1 and 5)
        and (energy is null or energy between 1 and 5)
        and (fatigue is null or fatigue between 1 and 5)
        and (soreness is null or soreness between 1 and 5)

generated.as: case when distance_meters > 0 then round(duration_seconds * 1000.0 / distance_meters, 1) end

session_plans_active_occurrence_uq.name: session_plans_active_occurrence_uq
session_plans_active_occurrence_uq.where: status = 'active' and occurrence_id is not null

session_plans_target_chk.name: session_plans_target_chk
session_plans_target_chk.value:
(occurrence_id is null and program_id is not null and program_day_id is not null
            and cycle_index is not null and day_index is not null and gym_id is not null
            and sport = 'strength')
          or (occurrence_id is not null and occurrence_revision_id is not null
            and sport <> 'strength')

activity_resources_pool_chk.name: activity_resources_pool_chk
activity_resources_pool_chk.value:
((pool_length_native is null) = (pool_length_unit is null))
        and ((pool_length_native is null) = (pool_length_metres is null))
        and (pool_length_native is null or (pool_length_native > 0 and pool_length_native <= 1000))
        and (pool_length_native is null or kind = 'pool')

activities_effort_chk.name: activities_effort_chk
activities_effort_chk.value:
(effort_status = 'reported' and effort_value is not null and effort_value between 1 and 5)
        or (effort_status = 'unknown' and effort_value is null)
        or effort_status = 'legacy_unconfirmed'

activities_origin_chk.name: activities_origin_chk
activities_origin_chk.value:
(occurrence_id is null and performed_revision_id is null)
        or (occurrence_id is not null and performed_revision_id is not null)

activities_plan_requires_origin_chk.name: activities_plan_requires_origin_chk
activities_plan_requires_origin_chk.value: performed_plan_id is null or occurrence_id is not null

activities_duration_chk.name: activities_duration_chk
activities_duration_chk.value: duration_ms is null or (duration_ms > 0 and duration_ms <= 604800000)

activities_endurance_completed_chk.name: activities_endurance_completed_chk
activities_endurance_completed_chk.value: sport = 'strength' or (status = 'completed' and duration_ms is not null)

cycling_details_values_chk.name: cycling_details_values_chk
cycling_details_values_chk.value:
(distance_metres is null or distance_metres >= 0)
        and (legacy_out_of_bounds or distance_metres is null or distance_metres <= 10000000)
        and ((distance_metres is null) = (distance_native_value is null))
        and ((distance_metres is null) = (distance_native_unit is null))
        and (average_power_watts is null or average_power_watts between 0 and 5000)
        and (average_cadence_rpm is null or average_cadence_rpm between 0 and 300)
        and (average_heart_rate is null or average_heart_rate between 20 and 300)
        and (max_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate between 20 and 300)
        and (average_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate >= average_heart_rate)
        and (elevation_gain_metres is null or elevation_gain_metres between 0 and 100000)
        and (resource_label is null or length(resource_label) <= 80)

running_details_values_chk.name: running_details_values_chk
running_details_values_chk.value:
distance_metres >= 0
        and (legacy_out_of_bounds or distance_metres <= 1000000)
        and (average_heart_rate is null or average_heart_rate between 20 and 300)
        and (max_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate between 20 and 300)
        and (average_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate >= average_heart_rate)
        and (cadence_steps_per_minute is null or cadence_steps_per_minute between 0 and 400)
        and (treadmill_incline_percent is null or treadmill_incline_percent between -100 and 100)
        and (treadmill_incline_percent is null or environment = 'treadmill')
        and (elevation_gain_metres is null or elevation_gain_metres between 0 and 100000)
        and (surface is null or length(surface) <= 80)

swimming_details_values_chk.name: swimming_details_values_chk
swimming_details_values_chk.value:
(active_ms is null or (active_ms > 0 and active_ms <= 604800000))
        and (distance_metres is null or distance_metres >= 0)
        and (legacy_out_of_bounds or distance_metres is null or distance_metres <= 1000000)
        and ((distance_metres is null) = (distance_native_value is null))
        and ((distance_metres is null) = (distance_native_unit is null))
        and (lengths is null or (lengths between 1 and 1000000))
        and (stroke_count is null or stroke_count between 0 and 1000000)
        and (pool_length_native is null or (pool_length_native > 0 and pool_length_native <= 1000))
        and ((pool_length_native is null) = (pool_length_unit is null))
        and ((pool_length_native is null) = (pool_length_metres is null))
        and (average_heart_rate is null or average_heart_rate between 20 and 300)
        and (max_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate between 20 and 300)
        and (average_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate is null or max_heart_rate >= average_heart_rate)
        and (resource_label is null or length(resource_label) <= 80)

swimming_details_method_chk.name: swimming_details_method_chk
swimming_details_method_chk.value:
(distance_method = 'lengths'
            and environment = 'pool' and lengths is not null and pool_length_native is not null)
        or (distance_method = 'manual' and lengths is null and distance_metres is not null)
        or (distance_method = 'unknown' and lengths is null and distance_metres is null)

planned_occurrences_programme_chk.name: planned_occurrences_programme_chk
planned_occurrences_programme_chk.value:
(family_id is not null) or (slot_lineage_id is null and cycle_index is null
            and cycle_day_index is null and original_week_index is null)

multisport_links_kind_chk.name: multisport_links_kind_chk
multisport_links_kind_chk.value: length(source_kind) between 1 and 60 and length(target_kind) between 1 and 60

food_entries_values_chk.name: food_entries_values_chk
food_entries_values_chk.value:
meal in ('breakfast', 'morning_snack', 'lunch', 'afternoon_snack', 'dinner', 'evening_snack')
        and position >= 0
        and amount > 0 and amount <= 10000
        and char_length(name) between 1 and 80
        and portion_amount > 0 and portion_amount <= 10000
        and unit in ('g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', 'oz', 'cup', 'tbsp', 'tsp', 'piece', 'slice', 'scoop', 'serving')
        and kcal between 0 and 10000
        and (carbs_g is null or carbs_g between 0 and 1000)
        and (fat_g is null or fat_g between 0 and 1000)
        and (protein_g is null or protein_g between 0 and 1000)

foods_values_chk.name: foods_values_chk
foods_values_chk.value:
char_length(name) between 1 and 80
        and portion_amount > 0 and portion_amount <= 10000
        and unit in ('g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', 'oz', 'cup', 'tbsp', 'tsp', 'piece', 'slice', 'scoop', 'serving')
        and kcal between 0 and 10000
        and (carbs_g is null or carbs_g between 0 and 1000)
        and (fat_g is null or fat_g between 0 and 1000)
        and (protein_g is null or protein_g between 0 and 1000)

meal_items_values_chk.name: meal_items_values_chk
meal_items_values_chk.value:
position >= 0
        and (name is null or char_length(name) between 1 and 80)
        and kcal between 0 and 10000
        and (carbs_g is null or carbs_g between 0 and 1000)
        and (fat_g is null or fat_g between 0 and 1000)
        and (protein_g is null or protein_g between 0 and 1000)

nutrition_targets_values_chk.name: nutrition_targets_values_chk
nutrition_targets_values_chk.value:
daily_kcal between 500 and 10000
        and protein_per_kg between 0.5 and 4
        and macro_split in ('body_weight', 'fixed_55_25_20')

saved_meals_values_chk.name: saved_meals_values_chk
saved_meals_values_chk.value:
char_length(name) between 1 and 80
        and jsonb_typeof(items) = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length(items) between 1 and 30

public.profile_directory.definition:
select p.id, p.username, p.display_name, p.created_at as joined_at, p.follow_approval,
      (select count(*)::integer from public.follows f where f.followee_id = p.id and f.status = 'accepted') as followers,
      (select count(*)::integer from public.follows f where f.follower_id = p.id and f.status = 'accepted') as following
      from public.profiles p
public.profile_directory.name: profile_directory
